description: The bot picks from the Nifty MidSmallcap 400 index. From the stocks in an uptrend it holds the 20 calmest stocks among the top third by 6-month rise. Stocks are re-picked monthly. It invests less when the market is unusually jumpy (checked weekly). 0.2% cost per trade. Prices from Yahoo Finance (may be delayed ~15 min).
